game.rules:
# General rules

- Speedrunning is the act of playing a video game with the intent of completing it as fast as possible. Runs will be rejected if this intent is not present, at verifier discretion.
- Original audio must be audible for the whole run. However, runs with limited or no audio may still be verified at verifier discretion.
- Your run may not be tool-assisted in any form, including but not limited to macros, scripts besides the solo script, any form of network manipulation, and cheats.
- Runs with strategies designed around the use of limited time global buffs (such as Solstice Empowerment) will be rejected.
- Strategies exploiting the game's connection-based nature will be reviewed for consistency between fireteams of different player compositions before being permitted.
- Exploits or strategies that Bungie has expressed the intention to patch or have precedent in being patched by Bungie are not permitted until it is clear that they will remain in the game.
- Any glitch listed in [this forum post](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/pnnuu) is not allowed in any run.
- For information on artifact mod bans, please see [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/v95ms).

# Submission standards

- Video proof of the entire duration of the run for at least one encounter POV and one POV for each out-of-bounds/skip player is required for all runs. 
- Runs that do not use the activity completion banner as their end condition must demonstrate that the strategy being employed in the run would result in a successful activity completion.
- Supported websites include YouTube, Twitch, and bilibili.
- For top 3 submissions, the POV of the player that makes the first input affecting the run's time is required, and the run will be timed based off of this POV in order to avoid discrepancies.
- Moderators reserve the right to retroactively reject or remove runs where submitted video evidence is deleted, made private, or otherwise inaccessible.
- Corrupted gameplay or gameplay obscured or impacted by overlays may be rejected (non-intrusive overlays such as DDT and threepole are permitted).

# Starting conditions

- Starting with any weapon equipped is allowed, provided that it is not fired or prepped in any way (Lament cannot be charged, Izanagi's Burden cannot be honed, Eager Edge cannot be active, etc.).
- Any run utilizing an ability that a player would not have if they had started the activity immediately upon load-in may be rejected at verifier discretion.
- Valid starting positions are limited to where a player could randomly spawn upon loading into the activity (read category rules for exceptions).

# Timing

- Runs generally end on one of the five following conditions (see category rules for exceptions):

1. Boss healthbar flash/death
2. First frame of mission complete banner
3. First frame of mission summary line
4. Last frame of level visible
5. Frame after interact is filled (empty circle)

  ![](/static/blob/kzwo3d8e.png)

- After cutscenes and loading screens, timer resumes on either the first input that affects the run or optionally when the level becomes visible for the player with the slowest load.
- Runs with strategies involving wipe screens or rejoins will have wipe screens equalized to 17s in raids and 7s in dungeons and levels (timed from leaderboard black screen to first visible spawn frame), while rejoins will be equalized to simulate perfect load times (equalization specifics can be found in category rules).

For more information on category-specific rules, check the individual category rules by clicking "Show rules" at the top right corner of a leaderboard. If you have further questions, feel free to head to our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/d2speedrun).

categories.name: Dares of Eternity
categories.rules:
**Dares:**

* This activity must be run on Legend difficulty.

* All seasonal artifact mods are ALLOWED in Dares of Eternity runs.

**Timing:**

* Timer STARTS when any player moves from their spawning position and/or performs actions that could affect the speed of the run. Players may move to different positions at spawn, as long as they are still in the default spawning positions. Runs started with any players super bar past the grenade icon (10%) will be invalidated. 

* Timer ENDS on the frame the Mission Complete banner is first visible, or when "View Mission Summary" appears in the top left.

* The timer is not paused for any wipe screens.

categories.name: Fishing
categories.rules:
**Fishing:**

* Players must begin in a valid spawning position (one that could be fast travelled to without moving).

* Players are not allowed to matchmake with others in order to influence the circumstances of their run.

**Timing:**

* Timer STARTS on the first input that affects the run.

* Timer ENDS on the frame that the caught fish appears on the right side of the screen.

* Timer will PAUSE when the player enters any load zone, and resume when the camera begins to move after any loading screen.

* Timer will PAUSE when the player touches the ground near the pond if it is unloaded, and resume when the pond finishes loading in.

categories.name: The Final Shape
categories.rules:
# Start and end conditions

- Timer starts on the frame that the first mission of the campaign is launched.
- For the purposes of LRT timing, any time not spent in a play area will be removed, including but not limited to loading screens, cutscenes, and orbit time. Time spent in play areas outside the campaign will still be included in the final LRT time.
- Timer ends on the frame the screen goes black after the final mission of the campaign.

# Miscellaneous

- All missions must be played from a fresh state. Restarting a mission from a checkpoint obtained this way is permitted, but no preexisting checkpoints may be used.
- For campaigns after Beyond Light, the campaign quest does not need to be completed. Instead, all campaign missions accessible from the directory must be completed in chronological order on the same character.

games.name: Destiny 2 Story
games.rules:
# General rules

- Speedrunning is the act of playing a video game with the intent of completing it as fast as possible. Runs will be rejected if this intent is not present, at verifier discretion.
- Original audio must be audible for the whole run. However, runs with limited or no audio may still be verified at verifier discretion.
- Your run may not be tool-assisted in any form, including but not limited to macros, scripts besides the solo script, any form of network manipulation, and cheats.
- Runs with strategies designed around the use of limited time global buffs (such as Solstice Empowerment) will be rejected.
- Strategies exploiting the game's connection-based nature will be reviewed for consistency between fireteams of different player compositions before being permitted.
- Exploits or strategies that Bungie has expressed the intention to patch or have precedent in being patched by Bungie are not permitted until it is clear that they will remain in the game.
- Any glitch listed in [this forum post](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/pnnuu) is not allowed in any run.
- For information on artifact mod bans, please see [this thread](https://www.speedrun.com/destiny2/forums/v95ms).

# Submission standards

- Video proof of the entire duration of the run for at least one encounter POV and one POV for each out-of-bounds/skip player is required for all runs. 
- Runs that do not use the activity completion banner as their end condition must demonstrate that the strategy being employed in the run would result in a successful activity completion.
- Supported websites include YouTube, Twitch, and bilibili.
- For top 3 submissions, the POV of the player that makes the first input affecting the run's time is required, and the run will be timed based off of this POV in order to avoid discrepancies.
- Moderators reserve the right to retroactively reject or remove runs where submitted video evidence is deleted, made private, or otherwise inaccessible.
- Corrupted gameplay or gameplay obscured or impacted by overlays may be rejected (non-intrusive overlays such as DDT and threepole are permitted).

# Starting conditions

- Starting with any weapon equipped is allowed, provided that it is not fired or prepped in any way (Lament cannot be charged, Izanagi's Burden cannot be honed, Eager Edge cannot be active, etc.).
- Any run utilizing an ability that a player would not have if they had started the activity immediately upon load-in may be rejected at verifier discretion.
- Valid starting positions are limited to where a player could randomly spawn upon loading into the activity (read category rules for exceptions).

# Timing

- Runs generally end on one of the five following conditions (see category rules for exceptions):

1. Boss healthbar flash/death
2. First frame of mission complete banner
3. First frame of mission summary line
4. Last frame of level visible
5. Frame after interact is filled (empty circle)

  ![](/static/blob/kzwo3d8e.png)

- After cutscenes and loading screens, timer resumes on either the first input that affects the run or optionally when the level becomes visible for the player with the slowest load.
- Runs with strategies involving wipe screens or rejoins will have wipe screens equalized to 17s in raids and 7s in dungeons and levels (timed from leaderboard black screen to first visible spawn frame), while rejoins will be equalized to simulate perfect load times (equalization specifics can be found in category rules).

For more information on category-specific rules, check the individual category rules by clicking "Show rules" at the top right corner of a leaderboard. If you have further questions, feel free to head to our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/d2speedrun).

# New Game

- **Original audio must be audible for the whole run, however, runs with limited or no audio can still be verified at the moderator's discretion**

# Timing

- Time with loads starts upon creating your character.
- Time with loads ends on the fade-out after you defeat Ghaul in Chosen.
- When timing without loads you remove loading screens, cutscenes, and time spent in orbit.

# Rules

- You may not use items that were not receiced on this character. This includes vault items, consumables in inventory and mods.
- Spending glimmer is allowed but you cannot drop below the amount you had before you started the run. (i.e Starting amount of 80,000 would be your minimum)
- Orbit times are counted as loads but at moderations discretion, if you are seen abusing this your run may be rejected.
- Each mission must be played fully. Restarting the mission with a checkpoint is allowed but starting the run with checkpoints on missions is not allowed.

(Last Updated January 20th, 2020.)

# A Guardian Rises

- **Original audio must be audible for the whole run, however, runs with limited or no audio can still be verified at the moderator's discretion**

# Timing

- Time with loads STARTS upon starting the "A Guardian Rises" mission.
- Time with loads ENDS on the Mission Complete banner of the "Advent" mission.
- When timing without loads you remove loading screens, cutscenes, and time spent in orbit. 

# Rules

- Orbit times are not counted as loads but at moderations discretion, if you are seen abusing this your run may be rejected.
- Each mission must be played fully. Restarting the mission with a checkpoint is allowed but starting the run with checkpoints on missions is not allowed.

# New Game Specific Rules

- The creation of the character you are running NG on must be shown in the video
- Any and all interactions made with DIM or any other Destiny item transferring application must be shown in the video.
- You may not use items that were not received on this character. This includes vault items, consumables/materials in inventory and mods.
- Spending glimmer is allowed but you cannot drop below the amount you had before you started the run. (i.e Starting amount of 80,000 would be your minimum)
- You may pull items from collections if you gather the necessary resources to in the run, but the items you pull must be those which start unlocked on a fresh f2p account or be unlocked during the run.
